title: List the folders of an installed Vault
summary: Gets the vault manager, picks an installed Vault (workspace) and lists its top-level folders with subtree counts, showing the EDMS asynchronous request pattern: start, wait with a timeout, check the outcome, read the result.
phrasings: list workspace folders from an extension
browse the folder tree of a connected workspace
call an EDMS request and wait for the result

commands.name: GetVaultFolders
commands.description: List the folders of an installed Vault
